expected_source: SPRU862B section 2.4 states that the C64x+ snoop protocol does not maintain coherence between L1P cache and L2 SRAM and that this is the programmer's responsibility, and section 2.6 gives the self-modifying-code procedure: invalidate L1P over the range that changed. So a routine already cached in L1P keeps running after IDMA1 overwrites it in L2 SRAM - 273 both times - and only a range invalidate through L1PIBAR and L1PIWC makes the replacement visible, giving 546. The checksum is those three results folded in Python
